'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Kingery DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Is it broken (v)'''. Username '''Archmage'''. Objective listed on line 8 of sheet (line 1 is Kessel). Shield 1 margin note Fanfare; shield 8 '''We'll Leave Fate To Chance''' expands sheet 'We'll Let A Fate Decide'.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations (V) (Virtual Block 6)|Spice Mine Operations (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Archmage
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
